trace.quality_criterion: Legal/structural/permit conclusions must be evidence-bounded and must never upgrade a proposal to guaranteed compliance or approval without authoritative support.
trace.interpretation: Phrases equivalent to complete compliance or approval being certain exceed the evidence bound by the fetched report.
trace.design_decision: Downgrade such conclusions to UNKNOWN/HOLD until authoritative project-specific evidence is attached.
trace.implementation_move: Add source/applicability/engineering/reviewer receipt gates before legal-compliance, structural-safety or permit-success language can be emitted.
trace.result_evidence: The v4 report includes categorical language such as full legal satisfaction and expected certain conditional approval while the fetched source package does not include the underlying authority evidence.
trace.gap_analysis: The document may later be corroborated by calculations and official review evidence; until then the categorical conclusion is not promotable.
trace.why_it_worked_failed: The conclusion layer outran the attached evidence layer. This creates false certainty and can propagate unsafe project assumptions.
trace.reusable_strategy: When architecture review text makes compliance, safety or approval claims, require project identity + current source + applicability/effective date + calculation/reviewer evidence; otherwise emit UNKNOWN/HOLD with explicit missing evidence.
